question: Agricultural credit has grown significantly since liberalisation, though distribution remains uneven. Which institution is the apex body for rural credit in India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**NABARD**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **NABARD** stands for **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development**.
 
• It was established in **1982** under the **National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development Act, 1981**.
 
• **NABARD** is the **apex body for rural credit** in India and is tasked with providing credit and development assistance to the **agricultural sector, rural infrastructure, and allied activities**.
 
• It plays a crucial role in promoting **agricultural growth** and facilitating the development of rural areas&l
